title: SecretUseResult
description: network.secret-use-result@1 (ADR-056): POST /internal/secrets/use's answer — the secret's name and version with the HMAC-SHA256 signature (sign) or the value (reveal). Sent with Cache-Control: no-store; a caller keeps a revealed value only as long as the request it is for.

signature.description: sign: the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the message under the secret.
